name: prepared-environment-and-experience
description: Experience-based and environment-based learning design drawn from Dewey and Montessori. Covers Dewey's criterion of continuity and interaction, the reflective-thinking cycle, Montessori's prepared environment, sensitive periods, child-led inquiry, the role of self-correcting materials, project-based learning, and the relationship between autonomy and discipline. Use when designing hands-on activities, arranging learning spaces, integrating classroom work with real experience, or evaluating whether a lesson is genuinely experiential versus merely "activity-based."
